title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. However, in response to your proposal for a 24-month agreement with 90-day payment terms, we can adjust our offer to €4.94 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – cost basis and multi-year offer
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer. We cannot reconcile €4.94 with the cost drivers you yourself named. PPI-C2815 moved from 118.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08) to 119.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08), a change of +0.84%. LCI-C moved from 116.5 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06) to 119.6 (idx:LCI-C@2026-06), a change of +2.66%. Weighted by your stated shares, this supports well under 1% on our current €4.39, not 12.5%.

You indicated that multi-year volume agreements change prices, so we propose the attached 24- and 36-month packages. Could you share the calculation your owner offered to walk us through? If this exceeds your authority, could you request an authorized pricing review?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – cost basis and multi-year offer
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have verified the index data you cited; while accurate, it does not change our pricing position. As to the index change data you cited, that does not change our position. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown and pricing review, our management has authorized this offer and our internal calculations remain proprietary. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In response to your proposed 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms, we can adjust our offer to a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – 36-month commitment and delivery performance
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the 36-month alternative. Your Q3 scorecard (sc:70620@2026Q3) shows 302 ppm, about twice the 150 ppm in your standard terms. The same scorecard (sc:70620@2026Q3) records only 85.0% on-time delivery. The extra quality and delivery effort is a cost we carry, and it needs to be reflected in the price.

You said multi-year volume agreements change prices. We therefore offer a firm 36-month commitment. Please see the attached packages.

If a lower price is possible at 90 days or 36 months, please make it your primary standing offer. Could you also tell us which variant gives you the most room on price?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal – 36-month commitment and delivery performance
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. 

We have verified the quality and delivery data you cited; however, it does not change our pricing position. As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm, and our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We present an Angebot with a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.
